title: Shell Scripts [.sh]
description:
# Shell Scripts
A `.sh` file is a script - a list of commands that run in order. Instead of typing commands one by one, you write them in a file and run them all at once.

To run a script:
1. Make it executable: `chmod +x script.sh`
2. Run it: `./script.sh`

Or skip step 1 with: `bash script.sh`
